title: HapBO: Harnessed $\alpha$-$\pi$ Bayesian Optimization via Expert Natural Language Priors
abstract: arXiv:2611.25100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) can be substantially more sample-efficient when informed by prior knowledge about the problem. In practice, however, such knowledge is often available only in natural language, e.g., expert intuitions or documentation, rather than as the explicit probability distribution landscape that prior-guided BO methods may require. Leveraging it effectively demands both an expressive mapping from language to priors and robustness to information that may be misleading. We propose HapBO (Harnessed $\alpha$-$\pi$ Bayesian Optimization), which elicits beliefs once from a human expert, a large language model (LLM), or both, and deterministically compiles a structured specification into a reusable belief function ($\pi: \mathcal{X} \to[0,1]$), with a rich representation not restricted to a Gaussian family. translated_title: HapBO：通过专家自然语言先验实现的 α-π 贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）在获得关于问题的先验知识时可以显著提升样本效率。然而在实践中，这类知识往往只能以自然语言的形式获得，例如专家直觉或文档，而非先验引导的BO方法所要求的显式概率分布图景。有效利用这类知识既需要从语言到先验的富有表现力的映射，也需要对可能产生误导的信息保持鲁棒性。我们提出HapBO（Harnessed α-π 贝叶斯优化），它从人类专家、大语言模型（LLM）或两者中一次性引出信念，并将结构化规范确定性地编译为可重用的信念函数（π: X → [0,1]），其表示形式丰富，不限于高斯分布族。基于 α-πBO，HapBO 通过在任意非负[函数上]施加有界正乘数来应用这一信念函数……
tldr: 该论文提出HapBO方法，将从人类专家或大语言模型一次性引出的自然语言先验确定性地编译为不限于高斯族的可重用信念函数，从而提升贝叶斯优化的样本效率，并对可能误导的信息保持鲁棒。
en_tdlr: HapBO deterministically compiles one-shot natural language priors from human experts or LLMs into a reusable, non-Gaussian-restricted belief function, boosting the sample efficiency of Bayesian optimization while remaining robust to potentially misleading information.
